sources.title: Local Plan proposals map
sources.role: Interactive proposals map and policies-map route; map coverage is not parcel membership proof.
sources.evidence: Council page provides policies map and an interactive GIS proposals map.

sources.title: Local Plan evidence base and GIS layers
sources.role: Official GIS ZIP route including all maps and Regulation 19 Site Allocations.
sources.evidence: Council publishes GIS Layers of the Local Plan Policies Map, including All Maps and LBE Reg19 Site Allocations ZIPs.

sources.title: New Enfield Local Plan
sources.role: Emerging plan evidence only; must not replace adopted-plan confirmation.
sources.evidence: Council page identifies Regulation 19 consultation documents and Appendix C Site Allocations.

sources.title: Adopted plans
sources.role: Primary adopted-plan confirmation route for Enfield.
sources.evidence: Council page lists adopted plans and the policies map.

sources.title: Local Development Scheme
sources.role: Plan-preparation timetable and progress context; not parcel membership proof.
sources.evidence: Council states the LDS was revised in May 2025 and sets the plan-preparation programme.

sources.title: Planning policy overview
sources.role: Official planning-policy entry point and growth-policy context.
sources.evidence: Council states planning policies manage development and identifies the Havering Local Plan 2021.

sources.title: Adopted Local Development Plan Documents
sources.role: Primary adopted plan and north/south policies-map route.
sources.evidence: Council records adoption on 17 November 2021 and links Policies Map North and South 2021.

sources.title: Evidence base for the Local Development Plan
sources.role: Evidence supporting the adopted Local Plan; not site membership by itself.
sources.evidence: Council identifies the page as evidence supporting the adopted Local Plan 2016-2031.

sources.title: Local Plan update
sources.role: Emerging update context; must remain separate from current adopted plan.
sources.evidence: Council describes why the Local Plan is being updated and that policies require supporting evidence.

sources.title: Brownfield Land Register
sources.role: Official borough brownfield register and site-map route; candidate binding requires record-level match.
sources.evidence: Council states it publishes the Havering Brownfield Land Register and site maps under the data standard.

sources.title: Lambeth Local Plan 2021
sources.role: Primary adopted-plan confirmation route for Lambeth.
sources.evidence: Council states the plan was adopted on 22 September 2021 and covers 2020-2035.

sources.title: Local Plan Policies Map
sources.role: Official policies-map route; visual map presence is not parcel-level membership proof.
sources.evidence: Council page directs users to Policies Map 2021.

sources.title: Planning constraints property route
sources.role: Property-level constraints verification route using the planning database and policies map.
sources.evidence: Council states the planning database includes policy and listed-building constraints and the policies map is free to search.

sources.title: Site Allocations Development Plan Document
sources.role: Site-specific emerging allocation evidence; do not treat as adopted until adoption is confirmed.
sources.evidence: Council states the Inspector's Report was received on 3 March 2026 and the document proposes 13 sites; the page says it will form part of the plan once adopted.

sources.title: Notice to commence new Lambeth Local Plan
sources.role: Future plan-preparation status only; current adopted plan remains Lambeth Local Plan 2021.
sources.evidence: Council decision was 30 June 2026, notice published 16 July 2026, and preparation is expected to begin 31 October 2026.

operation_plan.candidate_routing: Each candidate is routed only to the five official sources for its canonical borough.
